Mega Evolution series · PBL

Pitch Black

Released July 17, 2026 · 120 cards

StandardExpanded

Pitch Black is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Mega Evolution series, released in English on July 17, 2026. Its main set has 84 cards, plus 36 secret rares numbered beyond the set (120 in total). It includes 95 Pokémon, 23 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
